programmes.d: A threatening range war brings a mercenary gunman to Dodge City.
Doc Adams, who's been kidnapped to treat a wounded outlaw, is later asked by one of his abductors to teach him medicine.
Matt leaves Dodge City unprotected when he sets out to find a killer.
A man claims to be a sheriff from Texas, but a murder gets everyone suspicious about him.
Print Asper wishes to leave his ranch to his sons, but his attorney has other plans.
A young man kills a notorious gunfighter in self-defense and becomes the victim of an unscrupulous reporter's publicity buildup.
Pretty Aggie Dutton is so anxious to settle down she lies to her father and tells him Chester wants to marry her.
Festus, a young widow, and her two children are held hostage by a gang of outlaws

Paul Stevens and Victor French guest as opposite types who must face each other when a young boy is killed by one of them. Meanwhile, the son of a Russian immigrant, Moshe Gorofsky, is killed in a brutal hazing accident by a hooligan named Ruxton.
Two innocent men seem certain to lose their lives as a result of an old man's wild story.
The man who threatened to kill Chester arrives in town.
Bank robbers take Kitty hostage.
Louie Pheeters, the town barfly, witnesses a murder and tells the killer about it, thereby becoming the target of a deadly plot.
An outlaw's vow to free his brother from jail leads to threats and violence against Marshal Dillon's friends.
A series of seemingly random killings have the citizens of Dodge in near panic, but Dillon believes they are part of a pattern in which Doc is slated to be the next target.
A vicious gunman, unable to collect a $1000 bounty, blames Matt Dillon for this loss and sets up an ambush on him.
The love of a rancher’s daughter for a homesteader’s son adds fire to a land feud between their fathers.

A retarded young man becomes the ward of Festus. A young man named Billy arrives in Dodge to visit his best friend, Festus. When the teenager, who has no family and is retarded, attacks and injures a drover for tormenting a cat, he is arrested.
A down-on-his-luck cowboy accused of murder saves Marshal Dillon's life and Dillon defends him. (TV-PG)

Angered when Marshal Dillon breaks an important date, Miss Kitty goes off to visit friends and comes upon a handsome stranger.
The residents of Dodge are wondering where Joe Nadler gets all his money – and where he goes to spend it.
An old girlfriend asks Matt to protect her from her husband.
Kitty is named the sole heir in Crowbait Bob's will.
A wealthy alcoholic flees from his daughter and her fiance who are attempting to gain control of his estate.
Matt Dillon delays his pursuit of an outlaw in order to help a young boy search for his mother.
Marshal Dillon confronts the outlaw whose pursuit he had delayed to help a small boy find his mother.
A crafty rancher tries to frame his wife with a hired hand in a plot to force money from her father.
The widow of a cattleman falls in love with the man who supposedly killed her husband.
